featured_reviews.review_text: TBH - The Baker's House (Reon) is a magician when it comes to creativity in cakes. I was frantically looking for someone in Vasai who could design a very precise and complicated custom cake. While there are many options, I was drawn to TBH looking at his past work. I felt my required cake design would be too complicated for anyone (crochet themed cake with some rainbows and butterflies), but Reon nailed it!!! The cake was perfect which completely exceeded my expectations. It was mixture of white chocolate, Nutella, Hazelnut and dark chocolate. Everyone who tasted it loved it. And finally I must say that it was worth every penny. Very fairly priced. I would highly recommend Reon aka TBH - The Baker's House to everyone for not only their delicious cakes, but especially for some well designed special custom cakes.
